coreMemory.chinese: 给；给予；提供；提供信息、建议或意见；使产生；带来；导致；产生某种结果
coreMemory.english: v. to hand, provide, or transfer something to someone；v. to communicate information, advice, or an opinion；v. to cause someone to have a feeling, opportunity, or result；v. to cause or produce a particular result
coreMemory.structure: give someone advice /ˈɡɪv ˈsʌˌmwʌn æˈdvaɪs/（给某人建议）；give someone something /ˈɡɪv ˈsʌˌmwʌn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（给某人某物）；give something to someone /ˈɡɪv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈtuː ˈsʌˌmwʌn/（把某物给某人）；give up doing something /ˈɡɪv ˈʌp ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（放弃做某事）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ give up to doing something → ✅ give up doing something；❌ to giving → ✅ to give

commonErrors.note: “give up doing something”在本义下要求动词 -ing 形式；doing 是语法占位符，应换成具体动词的 -ing 形式，前面不要额外加 to。
这里的 to 是不定式标记，后面要用 give 的原形，不能改成 giving。

coreMemory.example: Could you give me some advice about pronunciation?
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 你能给我一些发音方面的建议吗？

meanings.english: to hand, provide, or transfer something to someone
meanings.example: The course gives each learner enough time to practise.
meanings.translation: 这门课程给每位学习者充足的练习时间。

meanings.english: to communicate information, advice, or an opinion
meanings.example: Could you give me some advice about pronunciation?
meanings.translation: 你能给我一些发音方面的建议吗？

meanings.english: to cause someone to have a feeling, opportunity, or result
meanings.example: A second attempt gives everyone a chance to improve.
meanings.translation: 第二次尝试让每个人都有改进的机会。

meanings.english: to cause or produce a particular result
meanings.example: Unclear instructions can give rise to avoidable mistakes.
meanings.translation: 不清楚的说明会导致本可避免的错误。

synonyms.difference: provide 更侧重“提供；供给”；give 的核心义是“给”。两者意思接近，但替换时仍要核对宾语、介词和具体语境。

antonyms.usage: 当 give 表示“给”时，take 表示“拿走；取得”。两者只在这个明确义项下构成直接对比，其他用法不能一概互换。

derivatives.note: 描述愿意给予帮助或时间的人。

confusables.difference: offer 表示“给予(物)；出价；提议”；give 在本卡核心搭配“give someone advice”中表示“给”。答题时要根据句意和完整结构区分，不只看拼写或中文近义。
